sentences.text: The matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
This Appeal has been preferred under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 against the judgment dated 27.04.2018 passed in L.A. Misc. Case No.64 of 2006.

3. Mr. Pradhan, learned Counsel for the private Respondents submits, this Court, vide judgment dated 06.03.2024 passed in L.A.A. No.109 of 2018, confirmed the judgment dated 19.05.2018 passed in L.A. Misc. Case No.70 of 2013 wherein the Court below held that the Petitioners are entitled for higher compensation @ Rs.15,000/- per decimal towards valuation of the acquired land.

Mr. Pradhan, further submits, the land of the present Respondents was acquired pursuant to the same notification and the Kisam of land of the present Respondents is also same as of the Respondents in L.A.A. No.109 of 2018 i.e. "Sarada Dofasal".
4. Pursuant to order dated 26.04.2024, a copy of the said judgment passed by this Court in L.A.A.
No.109 of 2018 being supplied to Mr. Chandrakanta Pradhan, learned Senior Panel Counsel for the Appellant-Union of India, he fairly concedes before this Court that this Appeal is squarely covered by the judgment of this Court dated 06.03.2024 passed in L.A.A. No.109 of 2018.
5. In view of the above, there being no infirmity or illegality in the impugned judgment, the Appeal stands dismissed.
6. The Appellant-Union of India is directed to act in terms of the judgment passed by the Court below dated 27.04.2018 in L.A. Misc. Case No.64 of 2006 within a period of eight weeks hence.
